{% autoescape off %}# SummarizePaper

> SummarizePaper (summarizepaper.com) publishes AI summaries of research papers from arXiv, open-access journals (any DOI) and preprint servers (bioRxiv, medRxiv, HAL, ChemRxiv, PsyArXiv and the other OSF servers, Europe PMC), in English and French. Each paper page gives a detailed summary, the key points, a lay summary anyone can understand, a blog-style article, related papers and the BibTeX entry, generated from the full text of the paper when its license allows it (CC BY, BY-SA, BY-NC, BY-NC-SA, CC0), from its abstract otherwise. It is free to read and is run by an astrophysics researcher, Quentin Kral.

Paper pages follow the pattern `https://www.summarizepaper.com/<lang>/arxiv-id/<id>/`, where `<lang>` is `en` or `fr` and `<id>` is an arXiv ID (https://www.summarizepaper.com/en/arxiv-id/2302.13303v1/) or, for other sources, `doi_` followed by the DOI with `/` written `--` (https://www.summarizepaper.com/en/arxiv-id/doi_10.1093--mnras--stad1234/). Every summarized paper is listed in the sitemap. Summaries are produced by OpenAI language models from the version published by arXiv, the publisher or the preprint server; the original paper remains the reference.

## Main pages

- [Home and search](https://www.summarizepaper.com/en/): look up any arXiv paper by title, keywords or arXiv ID, any paper by DOI or link, or search the open-access journals and preprints
- [Sitemap of summarized papers](https://www.summarizepaper.com/sitemap.xml): every paper and language that has a summary
- [FAQ](https://www.summarizepaper.com/en/faq/): how the summaries are made, limits, Premium, digest, exports, how to cite
- [About](https://www.summarizepaper.com/en/about/): who runs the site and why
- [Chat with papers](https://www.summarizepaper.com/en/chat/): an AI assistant that answers questions from the full text of one or several papers
- [About the author](https://www.summarizepaper.com/en/author/quentin-kral/): Quentin Kral, astronomer at the Paris Observatory
- [Daily digest](https://www.summarizepaper.com/en/digest/): a free weekday email with new papers in chosen arXiv categories and bioRxiv or medRxiv subject areas, each with a two-sentence summary

{% endfor %}
{% endif %}## Citation

Cite a summary with its paper page URL, for example https://www.summarizepaper.com/en/arxiv-id/2302.13303v1/, and the site as "SummarizePaper, https://www.summarizepaper.com, Quentin Kral". The BibTeX entry for the site is on the FAQ page. For scientific claims, cite the original paper.

## Optional

- [Premium](https://www.summarizepaper.com/en/premium/): the most capable model and higher daily limits, billed monthly or yearly
- [Privacy policy](https://www.summarizepaper.com/en/privacy/)
- [Source code](https://github.com/summarizepaper/summarizepaper): the site is open source
